rationale: Evaluated the applicable patterns against this workflow and repository context. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (setting fail-fast: true on the matrix jobs) is contraindicated: every matrix outcome (node version × OS × slow-test shard, and each feature flag) is required to preserve the intended build and test coverage, and the supporting evidence is synthetic with scenario_passed only and no measured repository savings. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be safely applied because there is no representative per-job successful-duration history (ci_history is explicitly not_a_measured_baseline / historical_context_only; full workflow runs are ~14-17 min across parallel jobs), so a safe timeout budget cannot be derived and valid slow macOS/Windows test runs risk false timeouts that would cancel required checks. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is already satisfied by the existing concurrency block with cancel-in-progress: true. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE cannot be verified because dependency installation occurs inside the composite action ./.github/actions/setup-environment whose internals are unavailable, so adding a cache step is speculative and could be redundant or conflicting. No supported, coverage-preserving optimization applies.
